equipmentSection.title: Modern Modalities & Facilities
equipmentSection.subtitle: We invest in high-grade therapeutic modalities to speed up recovery times and provide painless healing.

equipment.name: Class IV Deep Tissue Laser
equipment.description: Delivers targeted photonic energy up to 15W into deep tissues to stimulate mitochondrial ATP production, cut inflammation by up to 60%, and accelerate ligament and tendon repair.
benefits: Ideal for tennis elbow, plantar fasciitis, and acute sprains

equipment.name: Advanced TENS & 4-Pole IFT
equipment.description: Multi-channel interferential current that penetrates deep beneath superficial skin to block nerve pain pathways and relieve chronic lower back and neck muscle spasms.

equipment.name: Therapeutic Ultrasound (1 & 3 MHz)
equipment.description: High-frequency sound waves that create microscopic acoustic vibrations inside stiff tendons and joint capsules, breaking down scar tissue and increasing collagen flexibility.
benefits: Essential for frozen shoulder and bursitis

equipment.name: Dry Needling & Medical Cupping
equipment.description: Precision filiform needle insertion directly into muscular knots combined with vacuum cupping to restore oxygen flow, relieve trapped nerves, and release stubborn stiffness.
benefits: Releases knots that massage cannot reach
Relieves deep tension headaches and tech neck
Rapid increase in range of motion

equipment.name: Spinal Decompression Traction
equipment.description: Computerized cervical and lumbar traction table providing gentle, precise distractive force to widen spinal intervertebral spaces and pull herniated disc material off spinal nerves.
benefits: Relieves radiating leg pain and sciatica

equipment.name: Resistance & Balance Kinetic Gym
equipment.description: Equipped with therapeutic Swiss balls, wobble boards, resistance bands, and functional cable systems designed to rebuild stability, coordination, and athletic performance.

patientStories.title: Real Recovery Stories from Pune
patientStories.subtitle: Hear from working professionals, athletes, and senior citizens who regained active, pain-free lives with us.

stories.quote: Working 12-hour coding sprints gave me excruciating neck pain and numbness in my right fingers. Dr. Rahul identified cervical nerve compression, used manual traction and laser therapy, and helped set up my workstation. In 5 weeks, the pain and numbness were 100% gone.
stories.story: Arjun was unable to type without sharp radiating pain. With a combination of manual joint decompression and deep neck flexor strengthening, he resumed full productivity without any painkillers.

stories.quote: After my double knee replacement, I was terrified of walking or climbing steps. Dr. Meera was so gentle and encouraging. Within 8 weeks, I was walking in the society garden with my granddaughter without any walker or stick. A true blessing.
stories.story: Sunita achieved 115 degrees of knee flexion, mastered stair climbing, and regained her self-confidence through phased gait training and swelling control.

stories.recoveryTimeline: Back on the track in 10 weeks
stories.quote: I tore my hamstring just 10 weeks before the Pune Half Marathon. The team at Aarogya PhysioWell used Class IV laser therapy, dry needling, and eccentric strength rebuilding. Not only did I run pain-free, but I clocked 1:54:12 with zero discomfort.
stories.story: Rohan underwent functional movement screening and sport-specific plyometric drills before receiving full clearance for marathon competition.

stories.quote: Two spine surgeons had recommended microdiscectomy surgery for my shooting sciatica pain. Aarogya PhysioWell was my final conservative attempt. Dr. Meera's decompression protocols relieved 90% of my pain within four weeks. Today I am back to work without surgery.
stories.story: Priya avoided spinal surgery through precise computerized decompression traction, neural flossing exercises, and core stabilization routines.
